changelog: Shortcuts and unmatched icons are redrawn to match the icon pack. Backups are saved to the folder shown in Settings and remain after app data is cleared. The gallery widget asks for photo access, expands closer to the edges on narrow screens, and shows sharper thumbnails. Choosing a wallpaper from the gallery asks for storage access. If an older gallery plugin is installed, uninstall it and install it again.
changelogZh: 快捷方式和未适配图标会跟随图标包重画。桌面备份改存到设置页显示的目录，清除数据后仍然保留。相册小部件补上照片权限，窄屏展开更贴边，缩略图更清晰；从相册设置壁纸时会申请存储权限。已安装旧版相册插件的，请先卸载再重新安装。
